base_member_text: range(ns,ne) (L35) excludes ne, unlike the MATLAB ns:ne inclusive loop.
audit_member_text: End-bound off-by-one at L17-L18 and L35: an input described as the plot end number is excluded by range(ns,ne), so frame ne is never rendered; ns==ne renders nothing.

base_member_text: mask (L14) is loaded but never used.
audit_member_text: mask loaded from eta_00001 at L13-L14 is never used; eta masking instead relies only on eta>10 at L42.

base_member_text: The os.path.join('Users','Gaby',...) paths (L10-L11) are relative (no leading separator), so they resolve under the current working directory rather than the absolute /Users/Gaby intended by the comment at L8.
audit_member_text: The path components at L10-L11 start with 'Users' rather than '/Users' (or a drive/root), so despite appearing workstation-specific they are relative to the current directory; the user-path instruction does not match the constructed paths.

base_member_text: fdep+'depth.txt' (L20) concatenates without a path separator, producing '.../vessel_island_beachdepth.txt' — a path bug; os.path.join is used everywhere else.
audit_member_text: Definite path-concatenation defect at L11 and L20: fdep has no trailing separator, so fdep+'depth.txt' produces a path ending in 'vessel_island_beachdepth.txt' rather than a depth.txt child and normally fails before plotting.

base_member_text: '%.4d' applied to NUM*2.5 (L54) formats a float with an integer conversion; in Python 3 this raises no error only for whole floats via %d truncation semantics ('%.4d' % 2.5 actually raises TypeError in Python 3 for floats — script likely written for Python 2).
audit_member_text: Numerical formatting defect at L53-L55: (num-1)*2.5 can be half-integral, but %.4d truncates it to an integer (for example 2.5 becomes 0002), producing incorrect displayed seconds.
dispositions.rationale: blinded CONFLICT: %.4d on 2.5: X3 says truncates, Y3 says TypeError

base_member_text: dx=1.0 here (L26) versus dx=2.0 in the MATLAB sibling and mk_depth (dx=2.0); y0=2.0 (L25) also differs from the MATLAB y0=0.0 — coordinate axes will disagree with the depth grid actually generated by mk_depth.
The 2.5 s output interval implied by the title (L54) is unverifiable from this file.

audit_member_text: No dy exists and y at L29 reuses dx, forcing square spacing; eta dimensions are also not checked against dep-derived x/y before L44.
Matplotlib pcolor at L44 does not specify shading while coordinate lengths match eta dimensions, making edge coverage version-dependent.
